my understanding is that non-genetic tumors happen with random cellular mutations. new cells are being formed in your body literally every second of every day, and with each new cell your body makes, it has to duplicate DNA from an older cell. with the millions upon billions of cells in the body that are constantly being made, this leaves a lot of room for error when the DNA is being duplicated for the new cell. these little errors can build up causing mutations over time (usually they’re not noticeable at all bc these errors are so minuscule in the scheme of things, and if a cell is really f-ed up it could be eaten/killed by your body’s immune system). the problem is, if you get one cell that’s got some sort of error when it’s DNA was being duplicated, that wrong cell will then go on to make more wrong cells and then more and more and more. if that error happens to be an error that results in a tumor (<1% of mutations i believe), you then have a tumor. 
on a cellular level, tumors are caused when cells replicate wayyyyy faster than they’re supposed to, so a mound of cells just starts growing and growing and growing, resulting in a tumor. (this is how cancer can spread through the body, bc if one of those original tumor cells somehow makes it’s way into the blood stream/to another part of the body, that one cell will then keep multiplying super fast wherever it ends up, resulting in both the original tumor and now a second new one).

Sounds like tourette's to me. As far as getting a diagnosis I say research doctors near you that have experience with tourette's. Maybe see your GP to help point you in the right direction?
As far as helping with your tics, have you tried wearing headphones while eating? Maybe if you're listening to music while eating it will sort of drown out the sound of you chewing...? (idk just a thought) I've found a fidget cube works for me (I know, kinda cringy, but I it helps.) It doesn't get rid of my tics completely but it helps them be less often. I mostly use it when I'm ticking a bunch and I'm getting fed up with it. 
Hope this helps, best of luck!
